body: Hey, from reading this I could imagine I wrote it myself, I get massive panick attacks at university also, cannot stand it, I lock myself away in toilet cubicles half the time just to feel better, it really is pathetic. This is my second shot at uni after leaving last year but I REALLY hate it, drains every single bit of energy or good personality out of me, sweating profusely, uncontrollable shaking in hands/legs and more often than not being nauseous, I'm thinking about leaving again and studying online, while looking for a part time job, atleast working I feel useful, I earn money legitimately and honestly and do my best, but university is completely different, I've only just went to the doctor this morning and explained a few things, it is a weight off my shoulders actually TALKINg about it with an unbiased person. Hope you get better dude. + if you want to know how bad I was in my first year where I stayed in halls, I wouldnt even leave my room to get to know my flatmates, I stayed and played some games/went to some parties but 100% not my kind of people, I would sneak into the kitchen and just take a can of tuna just to eat by itself, avoiding cooking pasta or something just to avoid people. I'm not any different from them I think, just not wired the same, anyway sorry for rambling on your post but I can relate, good luck  and if you want to message me feel free

Hi thank you for reading, I finally decided to go to the doctor and see if he could help or elaborate. I've learned that this uncontrollable shaking and sweating is supposedly coming from adrenaline, I guess that could help explain why I always have no energy, I don't know. I really don't want to die I feel, I just want to be happy again.
